Educational high school mission supported by LAGRAPO.
Description

LAGRAPO has been working with students from Hiroo Gakuen Junior and Senior High School since December 2023 to create the satellite "ISHIKI." In this project, the students participated from the early stages of mission planning, experiencing the entire space business process of design, manufacturing, testing, and launch, and were able to successfully complete ISHIKI in just one year, an unusually short time for the development of a satellite. They were able to successfully complete ISHIKI while experiencing the entire business process
